title: Competition: Win a Garmin Fenix 8 smart watch with Engyne Health

Competition: Win a Garmin Fenix 8 smart watch with Engyne Health

It’s training season, and Engyne Health is giving Cyclist readers a chance to win a Garmin Fenix 8 smart watch.

Engyne Health is the new training platform from ex-pro cyclist and Le Col founder Yanto Barker. It provides personalised training advice and plans using the latest in AI tech, as well as clubs and leagues to compare not just times but also all your other metrics, so you can really see who’s the strongest rather than who has the best leadout.

Engyne also rewards users for training, with discounts from a massive range of brands including bike companies and high street stores including major supermarkets, plus loyalty points given out for every workout that add up to unlock entries to monthly prize draws.

  • Head to engyne-health.com to start your two-week free trial of the top tier Premium+ plan
  • Read more: Meet Engyne Health: Yanto Barker’s new do-it-all training app

To get your winter training started, Engyne is offering you the chance to win a Garmin Fenix 8 smart watch.

To be in with a chance of winning, write the answer to the question below in the form before 10th November 2026.
